claim_boundary: External physical-mechanism replication only. It is not streetlight field accuracy, municipal performance, fault recall, false-positive rate, or actual fault probability.
prohibited_inputs: rated load, lamp count, asset count, cabinet mapping
H1, Proxy, human review, field truth, or synthetic streetlight fields
imputed phase, timestamp, meter, unit, or channel fields

PMC-1.name: historical_contextual_baseline_deviation
PMC-1.definition: Robust residual from an entity-linked earlier reference with documented order and compatible physical scale.
PMC-1.surrogate_rule: A record-local or run-local reference is SURROGATE_ONLY and cannot support direct historical-baseline evidence.

PMC-2.name: persistence_temporal_accumulation
PMC-2.definition: Longest above-threshold run and cumulative duration over an ordered, contiguous source-native sequence.

PMC-3.name: phase_channel_asymmetry
PMC-3.definition: Robust magnitude contrast among documented aligned current channels on a common physical scale.
PMC-3.ceiling: Channel contrast only; never negative sequence, zero sequence, symmetrical components, or a fault type.

PMC-4.name: abrupt_structural_change
PMC-4.definition: Two-sided CUSUM of calibrated robust residuals with k=0.5 and h=5.0.
PMC-4.ceiling: Change observation only; no causal attribution.

PMC-5.name: multivariate_evidence_consistency
PMC-5.definition: Equal-weight mean of calibration percentile ranks from at least two available, non-duplicate PMC scores.

PMC-1.reason: Historical entity linkage and timestamp retention must be verified; no record-relative substitute is direct evidence.

PMC-2.reason: Minute-level data are described, but contiguous ordering and gap semantics require confirmation.

PMC-3.reason: No documented current phase/channel fields in reviewed metadata.

PMC-4.reason: Requires verified ordered series and calibration reference.

PMC-5.reason: Voltage and THD can contribute only after unit, duplication, and preprocessing provenance are verified.

PMC-1.reason: Pre-injection run-local current reference is not historical meter-relative context.

PMC-2.reason: Ordered high-rate waveform and injection intervals are described; activation still needs manifest verification.

PMC-3.reason: Two named current channels may support channel contrast, not a complete three-phase or symmetrical-component claim.

PMC-4.reason: Controlled interval onsets permit change-window evaluation after README verification.

PMC-5.reason: At least two non-duplicate current-channel/change components can be combined transparently.

PMC-1.reason: Earlier household/appliance history may form a contextual baseline only after appliance/day keys and time continuity are verified.

PMC-2.reason: Known state transitions and ordered measurements are described; a transition remains a positive control, not a fault.

PMC-3.reason: No A/B/C current-phase identity is assumed from the reviewed metadata.

PMC-4.reason: Known transition onsets can test structural-change response after alignment verification.

PMC-5.reason: Only non-duplicate voltage/current/power evidence may be combined; algebraic derivatives are not independent votes.
